subject.title: feat(discord/voice): add sessionChannelId to autoJoin for text-channel transcript routing

question: Should Discord voice text routing be added as a per-autoJoin `sessionChannelId` override, or should `voice.agentSession.target` remain the only supported bridge surface?
rationale: The current code already has a global `voice.agentSession.target` route, while the requested per-entry config would add public config and text-delivery semantics that affect session routing, message delivery, and mention behavior.

options.title: Add per-autoJoin bridge target
options.body: Approve a narrow per-entry target, then revise the linked implementation to validate same-guild text channels and pass an explicit Discord delivery target with tests and docs.

options.title: Keep `voice.agentSession` canonical
options.body: Document the existing global target as the supported path and narrow this issue to any missing automatic transcript/reply delivery semantics.

options.title: Defer to broader voice-as-I/O design
options.body: Leave this issue blocked until maintainers reopen or replace the broader Discord voice-as-I/O product design.

recommendation.title: Add per-autoJoin bridge target
recommendation.body: Approve a narrow per-entry target, then revise the linked implementation to validate same-guild text channels and pass an explicit Discord delivery target with tests and docs.

likelyOwner.reason: This account provided the most direct maintainer-side signal on the prior implementation PR that transcript routing changes need current channel-owner direction.
